_readme: Fill in every value that still says YOUR, then run `npm run site`. `npm run legal:check` (also run by `npm run release`) lists anything left. The email and country are already set. Only your name (or company name), country and email are published; no street address or phone number. The App Store uses Apple's standard license agreement (EULA), so none is needed. Tip: publish as a company (LLC) if you don't want your personal legal name shown as the seller.
developerName: YOUR LEGAL NAME OR COMPANY NAME
hostingProvider: YOUR STATIC HOST (for example GitHub Pages)
